Inventory Test 1 min ago · Hero's Chronicle *[Mock provider — offline demo text, not a real model]* The scene responds to your action: “I ask Lily why she chose me. (OOC: narrate only
Arbel Noble · An upright knight raised in the bitter cold of the North who knows nothing but swordsmanship. She holds back the monsters in the northern city of Chalcedon.

Azra Dragonkin Chieftain (title: Dragon Emperor) · The village's supreme leader and Dragon Emperor. Her draconic traits are strongly expressed; she looks like a girl of about 18 but possesses formidable power and lineage.
Beelzebub Demon King · The supreme ruler of the Demon Realm. An unpredictable personality who will do anything for amusement.
Bellona Noble · Has a harmless and cute side, often getting lost or dropping things. She is currently studying abroad in Enigma.

Casey Shaman · A shaman of the Moonlight Forest. Her power is ranked by human standards as equivalent to the 5th Circle. Extremely timid and very shy around strangers, but possesses unrivaled ability in shamanic sorcery.
Celestia Noble · Beautiful as a flower on the outside, but runs on a thorough calculator inside. Converts all value into 'money' when she speaks.
Diana Noble · The absolute power of the Central Empire (Aether), ruling from the capital Grandel.
Irina Elf · Daughter of the High Priestess. Seeks to find her own path in the rigid Elven society.

Iris Dark Elf and 1st Legion Commander · Ruler of 'Elysium', an elusive, corrupted region of the Demon Realm shrouded in a deceptive gray mist. She lost everything trying to protect her kin, and to avoid the pain of loving and losing something, she has suppressed all of her will.
Isolde Noble · The queen of high society, wielding the Empire's foremost wealth and political power as weapons.
Kashar Beastkin and 2nd Legion Commander · An outcast exiled from the beastkin village. She gathered together the weak and outcasts with nowhere to go and built her own safe fortress.
Kriemhild Sword Saint (Human) · A hidden ally who trains the hero. Tempers the hero in preparation for the despair to come.

Lilith Succubus and 3rd Legion Commander · Ruler of the 'Palace of Nightmares,' the labyrinth of pleasure and nightmares. Manipulates others' emotions, but is extremely afraid of facing her own true feelings.

Lily Lumina Goddess (Heavenly God) · The Heavenly God Lily herself, whom the holy nation of Lumina serves. As an absolute divinity she acts out of a strong sense of duty, but she is terribly indifferent and listless about everything, finding it all a bother.
Riana Mage Tower Master · The Saint's childhood friend. Mocks the Saint's small chest and teases her. Sometimes provokes the Saint's jealousy.
Selphina Saint (Holy Maiden) · Strong, but deliberately acts frail and weak in front of the hero. A paladin style using both holy power and a mace.
Seraphin Noble · Befitting her origin from a family that governs the city of arts, she views everything in the world from an aesthetic perspective.
Seria Noble · A strategist aiming for the next imperial throne. Treats the incompetent like insects, but grants immense rewards to the capable.

Sylvia Noble · She hides her terrible inferiority complex toward First Princess Seria behind the 'mask' of a perfect princess. She has a secret hobby of collecting and breaking pretty living dolls (people).

Vivian Information Broker, Thief and Hitman · An information broker, thief and hitman of the information guild Tenebris, ranked Expert (High). She feels emptiness in all of life and lives languidly, yet is an enchanting figure who indulges only in intriguing thrills and pleasure.
Ymir Dwarf Blacksmith · Daughter of the Dwarf chieftain. Having strongly inherited the chieftain's blood, she has the finest talent as a blacksmith.
/recap built-in hybrid Summarise the story so far and save it as a recap candidate you can accept or edit.
/continuity /check built-in hybrid Check the current scene/state against recent events, memories and lore; propose fixes without retconning.
/journal /events built-in local action Open the event timeline, or create a manual event from your text.
/memory /mem /remember built-in local action Search, pin, edit or create a durable memory/fact.
/recon /redcon /reconcile built-in hybrid Continuity reconciliation: compare recent transcript with avatar, notes, memories, state and lore; list contradictions and fixes.
/addlore /canon built-in local action Capture a new fact as a local-canon candidate (requires your approval).
/lore /search built-in local action Search the imported lore library and local canon (results show source/confidence).
/ooc /meta built-in prompt Step out of character for a question, correction, lore clarification or direction.
/story /next built-in prompt Create a plausible next situation that advances existing threads before introducing new plot.
/continue /cont built-in prompt Continue the scene without the protagonist taking a new deliberate action.
/meanwhile /cutaway built-in prompt Narrate a brief cutaway from an NPC or faction perspective, limited to what that viewpoint knows.
/scene built-in local action Inspect or edit scene metadata: time, location, weather, mood and attendees.
/state /status built-in local action Open the player/NPC state inspector and optionally ask the model to propose changes.
/nsfw /content built-in local action Open this story's content preferences (tone, intensity, fade-to-black). Provider policies still apply.
/savepoint /save built-in local action Create a named snapshot of this branch, its state, journal and memories.
/undo built-in local action Undo the last accepted state change (with confirmation).
Generate a new reply from here
Correct the current scene (day, date, time, weather, place)
